remarks: Looking for space, convenience, & a place to call home? This impressive CORNER CONDO UNIT in Tuscan Village checks all the boxes! Offering a generous 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout, this unit stands out with one of the building’s LARGER FLOOR PLANS & added bonus of 2 HEATED UNDERGROUND PARKING STALLS. The open living space is bright & inviting, with 9-foot ceilings, NEWER LAMINATE FLOORING, & a functional kitchen complete with rich espresso cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of room to prep & entertain. The large primary bedroom offers a WALK-IN CLOSET & private 3-PCE ENSUITE. A SECOND BEDROOM provides versatility for guests, family, or a home office. There is also a generous IN-SUITE LAUNDRY & storage room, plus a LARGE CORNER BALCONY. Set in a peaceful, well-kept complex, this location makes everyday living easy, with schools, shopping, restaurants, Anthony Henday Drive, & the military base all close by. (id:67522)
